server_status_values.ready: Account and required hardware were checked and are currently usable.
server_status_values.running: A training session currently owns the training lease on this server.
server_status_values.out_of_quota: Provider quota is exhausted or the configured quota threshold was reached.
server_status_values.kicked_out: The most recent session was terminated unexpectedly; retry only after cooldown.
server_status_values.unavailable_until: Manually or automatically marked unavailable until the recorded timestamp.
server_status_values.unknown: Not checked yet, or the provider does not expose enough information to verify availability.

servers.name: Kaggle Notebooks

limits.quota_notes: Kaggle documents 30 GPU hours per week or sometimes higher depending on demand and resources. The 12-hour limit applies to CPU/GPU notebook sessions; TPU sessions are limited to 9 hours.

requirements: Kaggle API token stored only as a GitHub Actions secret
Notebook metadata file for the user's Kaggle kernel
Kernels execute permission on the Kaggle token
automatic_start.limitations: This starts a notebook execution through Kaggle's API; it does not guarantee an interactive editor session or available GPU. Provider quota and accelerator availability still apply.

start_steps: Sign in to Kaggle and complete phone verification for GPU access.
Open the notebook page and create or import the repository's train.ipynb.
Select an available free GPU in Notebook Settings > Accelerator.
For an automated run, configure the Kaggle API token in GitHub Actions Secrets and register the kernel metadata.
servers.status_reason: Account verification, remaining GPU quota and accelerator availability have not yet been checked.

servers.name: Google Colab Free

limits.quota_notes: Free runtimes can run for at most 12 hours, depending on availability and usage patterns. GPU types, usage limits, idle timeout and VM lifetime vary and are not published as a fixed quota.

requirements: Google Cloud project and OAuth authorization
Colab API access for the account
A runtime client that connects and executes notebook code
automatic_start.limitations: The official API can create and manage Colab runtime assignments, but eligibility and execution for consumer Free accounts have not been verified. Keep this provider guided/manual unless a real Free-account test confirms the permitted flow.

start_steps: Open the repository's train.ipynb through the Colab GitHub link.
Choose Runtime > Change runtime type and select a free GPU if one is offered.
Add Supabase credentials through Colab Secrets, never notebook cells.
Press Runtime > Run all; if no GPU is offered, the notebook uses CPU settings.
servers.status_reason: Free GPU allocation and account usage limits are dynamic and cannot be determined from public documentation.

servers.name: Lightning AI Studios Free

limits.quota_notes: The Free plan lists one active free CPU Studio with 4-hour restarts. The FAQ states 5 credits at registration; 25 additional credits require adding a card. Credits are not a recurring monthly allowance. No payment method will be added for ULTRON.

requirements: Lightning API authentication stored only as a GitHub Actions secret
An existing Studio name and Teamspace
A free-plan hardware and credit check before start
automatic_start.limitations: The SDK can start and stop Studios programmatically. The switcher must select only the free CPU Studio unless the account explicitly reports sufficient no-cost credits; it must never enable pay-as-you-go or paid hardware.

start_steps: Sign in to Lightning AI and open the browser Studio.
Use the Free default CPU Studio unless free credits and a free GPU option are explicitly confirmed.
Open the repository train.py in the Studio browser terminal or editor.
Store Supabase credentials in environment secrets, not files.
servers.status_reason: Studio availability and remaining free credits must be checked in the user's account.

servers.name: GitHub Actions CPU Fallback

limits.quota_notes: Standard GitHub-hosted runners are free and unlimited for public repositories. Each workflow job can execute for up to 6 hours. Avoid storing checkpoints as Actions artifacts; use the configured checkpoint storage.

requirements: Workflow files committed to the default branch
Supabase secrets configured in repository Actions Secrets
automatic_start.limitations: A workflow can be triggered by an authorized dispatch or schedule. Scheduled starts can be delayed, and each job still ends at the 6-hour limit. Training must checkpoint and exit before that limit.

start_steps: Choose the ULTRON CPU training workflow.
Press Run workflow for a guided/manual start, or let the switcher dispatch it after eligibility checks.
The worker resumes from the newest verified cloud checkpoint.
servers.status_reason: Workflow has not yet been installed or run.
